INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

2. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

5. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.

6. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

11. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 6.3.1 Essay writing – expository composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Intensive listening: Transcription and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
